corrected_content.problem: Find a Cartesian equation of the plane that passes through the point $P(3,1,-4)$ and is perpendicular to the vector $\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{i}-2\mathbf{j}+5\mathbf{k}.$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
The normal vector is $\mathbf{n}=\langle1,-2,5\rangle$ and the plane passes through $P(3,1,-4)$. Use $\mathbf{n}\cdot(\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{p})=0$:

$$
(x-3)-2(y-1)+5(z+4)=0.
$$

Expanding and collecting the constants gives

$$
x-2y+5z+19=0.
$$
